crossRefs.note: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

translations.web: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
translations.bsb: But if they refuse to make peace with you and wage war against you, lay siege to that city.
